title: cloud supervisor's disagreement note tells the operator to free the lease with 'tk cloud stop', not ticfac's own command
description:
internal/cli/cloud_supervisor.go's cloudSupervisorDisagreement line — the one line the command exists for — ends with "Free the project lease with 'tk cloud stop %s --now'", naming ticks' CLI while this binary's own 'ticfac cloud stop --now' is the command that does it. The factory move ported the text verbatim and the pointer was never repointed.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding ddc08aebc0f469d15f7d613a8f0c191017c177730f2a248c347f471a77577c16 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-8v3/attempt-24): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A4. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/ddc08aebc0f469d15f7d613a8f0c191017c177730f2a248c347f471a77577c16.json on the run branch.
